text_block_list.text:
One day after training, as I'm walking<n>Biwa
Hayahide to her dorm just<n>before curfew...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Welcome back, Hayahide! It's rare to<n>see you out
and about at this late<n>hour.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I was training heavily today,<n>and—ah, are you
speaking in your<n>capacity as dorm leader? I'm
sorry to<n>come back so late.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, not at all! I adore the chance to<n>welcome back
my ponies after a hard<n>day's work, no matter the
time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
By the by, did you happen to see<n>Sweep and
Marvelous on your way<n>here?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
They're not answering their phones.<n>And as they
are among our younger<n>residents, I can't help but
feel a bit...<n>trepidatious.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
With good reason—we should search<n>for them
immediately. I'll help, of<n>course!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: My eternal gratitude to you both!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Might I suggest we split our efforts?<n>You two work
together in search of<n>one, and I shall look for the
other.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Right. Do you have any information on<n>where they
might be?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Only that Marvelous went off on a<n>so-called
"marvelous search," and<n>Sweep set out to look for
magic<n>ingredients.
choice_data_list: Sweep sounds easier to pin down.

Marvelous could be anywhere, so let's try to find
her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, there are a limited number of<n>items that might
be considered magic<n>ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's take advantage of that to find<n>Sweep as soon
as we can and bring<n>her back.

In case they come back on their own,<n>we leave a
note on the door for them<n>to call the dorm leader,
and then we<n>depart on our search.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Nope, that won't work. Ooh, and this<n>one's the
wrong color!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sweep! There you are!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek! Wh-what?! What're you<n>doing in my
favorite gathering spot?!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Looking all over for you, that's what!<n>At Fuji's
request.
choice_data_list:
You're about to miss curfew! Come on, let's go
back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: For real? I had no idea it was so late!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
B-but, I don't care! I'm not going<n>aaanywhere until
I find some<n>medicinal herbs, and that's that!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter? Perhaps we<n>can help you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're not the sort of magical girl to<n>simply break
rules for no reason,<n>after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Urk!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Rrrg... Fine! You're right, I'm not! But<n>my grandma
got a fever yesterday...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
And it won't come down, no matter<n>what I do. So I
wanna try healing her<n>with magic.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see. But if you don't make it back to<n>the dorm
before curfew, everyone's<n>going to be worried
about you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
They may even end up calling your<n>grandmother.
That's certainly not<n>what you want, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: O-of course not!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Then, it sounds like you really should<n>let us assist
in your search.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You can give us the most relevant<n>information, and
we'll use that to<n>narrow down potential harvesting
locations.
choice_data_list:
Then we can find those herbs and make it back on
time!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...O-okay, fine.

And so, thanks to Biwa Hayahide's<n>logic and
wisdom, we locate the<n>herbs in no time at all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Sweep! I'm so glad you've returned<n>home safe
and sound!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah, so, uh...<n>Thanksforyourhelptoday. Byyye!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me! I don't believe I've<n>ever heard her
say the word<n>"thanks." What manner of spell did
you cast on her?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No spell. I merely interjected myself<n>into her
personal affairs.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She reminds me of Brian when she<n>was little. I
couldn't resist helping her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, your "interjecting," is always a<n>boon to me, as
well as the whole<n>dorm.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Today certainly has been no<n>exception. I give you
my thanks,<n>Hayahide.

The slightest blush crawls across<n>Biwa
Hayahide's face in response to<n>the unexpected
compliment from Fuji<n>Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good idea. She'll be the more difficult<n>to track, so
considering that two<n>heads are better than one, we
should<n>take charge of finding her.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's first identify any nearby<n>locations which could
reasonably be<n>described as "marvelous."

In case they come back on their own,<n>we leave a
note on the door for them<n>to call the dorm leader,
and then we<n>depart on our search.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: She's not at the stage...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Not at the Three Goddesses statue,<n>either. Could
she be inside<n>somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Let's try to reason this out. What<n>"marvelous"
places might we find<n>indoors? The music room,
perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But with no one there right now,<n>calling it
"marvelous" seems a bit<n>inaccu—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
How exquisitely red and marvelous! ☆<n>So
marvelously sparkly! ★

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Marvelous?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Why, if it isn't Hayahide! What brings<n>you here? ☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I could ask you the same.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were on a "marvelous<n>search," but I still
have yet to grasp<n>what, exactly, that entails.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Well, um, I heard a marvelous rumor<n>that if you run
around inside the<n>school at night, a red light chases
you...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So I tried it, and it turns out it's true!<n>I've been
having so much fun with it!<n>☆
choice_data_list: That... sounds a lot like a ghost.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Th-the existence of ghosts s-simply<n>isn't
supported by any kind of<n>scientific evidence!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But... for argument's sake, if they do<n>exist, how...
might one go about<n>dealing with them?
Hellooo? Hellooooo?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Oh! It's the red light! ☆

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Whoa! ☆ You're really moving,<n>Hayahide! ★
choice_data_list: Wait. This red light is no ghost, it's...

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry. I didn't mean to scare<n>you.

text_block_list.name: Security Guard
text_block_list.text:
Shouldn't you be heading home so<n>you don't miss
curfew?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I believe I owe you both an apology.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I got a little spooked, I will admit, but<n>that doesn't
excuse me for running<n>off by myself.
choice_data_list: It's really nothing to worry about.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! All that matters is that our<n>combined efforts
have brought<n>Marvelous and Sweep back home
safe and sound.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Heh. But I must admit, never in my<n>wildest dreams
would I have<n>guessed you were afraid of ghosts!
How adorable!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Urk! I-I mean, who isn't scared of<n>ghosts?! Ghosts
are scary!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Almost nothing is known about their<n>behavior! What
are you supposed to<n>do if you see one?!
choice_data_list: But it was just a security guard, so it's fine!
But it was just a security guard, so it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And thank goodness for that. If it<n>were anything
else, I don't think I'd<n>be getting any sleep tonight at
all!

And with that, Biwa Hayahide lets out<n>a deep sigh
of genuine relief, slightly<n>embarrassed, but
ultimately no worse<n>for wear.
